name: 宣传机器 · Constructivist Propaganda
description: RepoChan's own constructivist propaganda poster wall: seven full-bleed posters (call / analysis / persona / foundation / painter / product / CTA) in a strict red-black-cream palette with diagonal bands, rings, halftone dots and bilingual stacked slogans. The character is subordinated to geometry — full-body cutouts are silhouetted at runtime via CSS mask (never re-cropped), and real order evidence anchors the product poster. zh default locale with a full en edition.

assets.description: Project icon — masthead badge and og:image; also the favicon source (favicon.ico / apple-touch-icon.png / icon-192.png / icon-512.png are derived from it offline via compress + favicon + resize).

mustInclude: one scalable brand mark reading cleanly at 30px (masthead badge size)
project motif without any letterforms, seal-stamp simplicity
creativeFreedom: accent colors from the project palette

assets.description: Full-body die-cut cutout A (dynamic full-frame pose) — the poster 01 symbol, silhouetted at runtime by CSS mask (red/halftone), never re-cropped. Slot declares the complete in-frame cutout; transparent webp produced by chroma-key + compress. Reference is the raw matte master (2:3).

brief.intent: Regenerate cutout A for the downstream project's character: a dynamic full-body pose that stays readable when reduced to a flat silhouette by CSS mask.
mustInclude: one full-body character in a dynamic pose, fully inside the canvas
bold uncluttered silhouette readable as a flat single-color shape
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character
avoid: fine wispy details that vanish in silhouette

assets.description: Full-body die-cut cutout B (forward-leaning open-palm pose) — the poster 03 symbol and the colophon seal stamp, silhouetted at runtime by CSS mask (black/red), never re-cropped. Slot declares the complete in-frame cutout; transparent webp produced by chroma-key + compress. Reference is the raw matte master (1:1).

brief.intent: Regenerate cutout B for the downstream project's character: a forward-leaning presenting/open-palm pose that stays readable as a small seal-stamp silhouette in the colophon.
mustInclude: one full-body character leaning forward with an open presenting palm, fully inside the canvas
bold uncluttered silhouette readable as a flat single-color shape at ≤120px
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character
avoid: fine wispy details that vanish in silhouette

assets.description: Foundation sheet — Fig. A of the product poster (screen 06), real pipeline evidence in a hard-offset frame. Reference is the source sheet master (1:1); the page asset is a JPEG q85 compress of it.

brief.intent: Regenerate the downstream project's foundation sheet (the consistency anchor every downstream order references) for display as order evidence Fig. A.
mustInclude: character key visual plus turnaround/expressions, palette and key props on one sheet
square 1:1 framing readable at ≤440px display size
avoid: busy scenery behind the sheet cells
creativeFreedom: expression and prop selection within the project identity

assets.description: Studio scene poster — Fig. B of the product poster (screen 06), real pipeline evidence in a hard-offset frame. Reference is the source poster master (3:2); the page asset is a JPEG q82 compress of it.

brief.intent: Repaint the world-scene studio poster for the downstream project: the character at work in its own world, shown as order evidence Fig. B.
mustInclude: the project character in a workspace/studio scene true to its world
landscape 3:2 framing readable at ≤440px display size
creativeFreedom: scene props and composition within the project world
palette rotation within the project identity
